chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Yunus, from Abu al-Abbas al-Baqbaq and Ubayd ibn Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to increase in his prayer during the month of Ramadan. When he prayed the 'Isha prayer, he would pray after it, so the people would stand behind him. He would enter (his chamber) and leave them, then he would come out again, so they would come and stand behind him. He would leave them and enter (again) repeatedly.
He said, and he said: 'Do not pray after the 'Isha prayer in other than the month of Ramadan.'
ai.seo_question: What was the Prophet's practice regarding night prayers after 'Isha during Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the Prophet’s (peace be upon him) voluntary night prayers in Ramadan, illustrating the distinction between his personal devotion and the later institutionalization of Taraweeh. The repeated entry and exit signify that while the congregation followed, the practice was not initially fixed as a communal obligation, a nuance central to Shia jurisprudence regarding the flexibility of *Sunnah* prayers. It concludes by noting this specific manner of praying after 'Isha was particular to Ramadan, emphasizing the unique spiritual elevation of the month.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ubeyd, from Yunus, from Abu Al Abbas Al Baqbaan, and Ubeyd Bin Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> used to increase in his<sup>saww</sup> Prayers during a Month of Ramazan. When he<sup>saww</sup> Prayed at dusk, Prayed after it, so the people would be standing behind him<sup>saww</sup>. So he<sup>saww</sup> would enter (his<sup>saww</sup> chamber) and leave them. Then he<sup>saww</sup> would come out as well, so they would be coming, and they would be standing behind him<sup>saww</sup>. So he<sup>saww</sup> would leave them, and he<sup>saww</sup> would enter his<sup>saww</sup> chambers time and again’.
He (the narrator) said, ‘And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Do not Pray after the dusk during other than a Month of Ramazan’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa ibn ‘Ubayd from Yunus from abu al-‘Abbas al-Baqbaq and ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that

the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, would increase his salat (prayer) during the month of Ramadan. After al-‘Atmah (late evening salat [prayer]), he would perform more prayers. People behind would stand up (for prayer), but he would go inside and leave them. Then, after he came out, they would come and stand up behind him (for prayer), but he would leave them and go inside several times.’
He (the narrator) has said that the Imam then said, ‘You must not perform salat (prayer) after late evening prayer during the times other than the month of Ramadan.’”
